title: 36k enemies repathing instantly (almost)
author: Such--Balance
selftext:
So i just used codex to migrate both pathfinding algorithms and enemy movement to c++ from in engine Godot.

massive improvement in functionality in both possible map sizes and total enemy numbers. Im pretty sure its still highly unoptimized and can probably be improved another 10x in efficiency.

Ive never used c++ so i was somewhat reluctant to migrate stuff to it. Would recommend though. Its just vastly more efficient for lost of stuff, and now in the days of ai doing the grunt work this really doesnt need all that much human effort to incorporate.

Heres some gains:

|Enemies|GDScript/update|Native/update|Speedup|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|500|1.64 ms|0.092 ms|17.7×|
|1,500|4.77 ms|0.208 ms|22.9×|
|3,000|9.76 ms|0.387 ms|25.2×|
|5,000|15.50 ms|0.622 ms|24.9×|

Measured accumulated CPU per completed wave, corridor maps, release build:

|Map|GDScript|Native|Speedup|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|100×100|91.0 ms|12.0 ms|7.6×|
|200×200|379.0 ms|47.1 ms|8.1×|
|512×512|2491.9 ms|313.9 ms|7.9×|

Absolutely disgusting. 

Keep in mind, im just a bag of meat with very little coding background and no pathfinding algorithm or optimization background whatsoever.

Im sure its possible to optimize it 10x more eventually with some finetuning. 

Im trying to build a few base pathfinding layers which should enable +- 500 active enemies on the map to path correctly, update asap to new or blocked of paths, and react to various layers in real time based off their 8 directional neighbors. 

This is the first layer which just points to the most optimal path. As my game eventually will have a lot off (breakable) walls, lots of fast and on the fly repathing is bound to happen and really this ground layer needs to both be dirt cheap compute wise, and update enemy pathing lighting fast.

36k is just a stress test as ill never gonna reach those numbers ingame. Any help is more than appreciated to if you have any tips or tricks or know some vids on this topic please let me know.
